summary.ko: 반복되는 용어·고유명사·말투를 일관된 번역 규칙으로 정리합니다.
summary.en: Build an evidence-based terminology and language-style reference for recurring translation work.

exclusions: One-off short translation with no terminology problem

required_inputs.description: Representative approved source and target text or source terminology
Languages, domain, audience, and existing terminology decisions

workflow.instruction: Extract recurring domain terms, product names, UI labels, ambiguous phrases, and tone patterns.
Separate approved usage from proposed translations and preserve evidence for each decision.
Define preferred and prohibited variants, context notes, capitalization, honorifics, numbers, and locale formatting.
Test the guide against representative passages and record unresolved terms with an owner or decision question.

deliverables.name: Bilingual glossary
deliverables.acceptance_criteria: Each entry has source term, target term, context, status, and supporting example

deliverables.name: Language style guide
deliverables.acceptance_criteria: Contains actionable rules and representative examples

limitations: Do not label inferred translations as client-approved.
A glossary must be revised when product meaning or audience changes.
permission_boundaries: Do not upload client corpora or overwrite a shared terminology system without approval.
Do not retain unnecessary personal data from source examples.
